TallyPrime Customization

TallyPrime Built
Around Your Business

Standard TallyPrime is powerful — but your business has unique workflows, reporting needs, and document formats. We customise TallyPrime to fit your operations precisely, so your team works faster and your reports tell the right story.

Discuss Your Requirements Chat on WhatsApp

What We Customise

From simple invoice templates to complex TDL integrations — we cover the full range of TallyPrime customisation.

Custom Invoice & Document Templates

Branded invoices, delivery notes, purchase orders, and receipts that match your company identity — with your logo, colours, terms, and layout exactly as you want them.

Examples

  • Tax invoice with eTIMS QR code
  • Delivery note with driver signature field
  • Proforma invoice template
  • Statement of account layout

Custom Reports & MIS Dashboards

TallyPrime's default reports don't always show what your management team needs. We build custom reports tailored to your KPIs, industry, and decision-making style.

Examples

  • Sales rep performance report
  • Branch-wise profitability
  • Ageing analysis by sales rep
  • Stock movement by category

TDL Customizations

Using Tally Definition Language (TDL), we extend TallyPrime's core functionality — adding new fields, automating calculations, and integrating with external systems.

Examples

  • Custom fields on vouchers
  • Automated commission calculations
  • Approval workflows
  • Integration with external POS or ERP

Payslip & HR Document Design

Professional payslips showing all Kenya-specific deductions — PAYE, NSSF, SHIF, Housing Levy, NITA — in a clear, employee-friendly format.

Examples

  • Branded payslip template
  • Leave application form
  • P9 form layout
  • NSSF/SHIF contribution schedule

Our Customisation Process

No surprises. Every project follows a clear 4-step process from requirements to delivery.

01

Requirements Gathering

We meet with your team to understand exactly what you need — what data to capture, how it should look, and what decisions it should support.

02

Design & Prototype

We build a prototype of the customisation and share it with you for review before any final development begins.

03

Development & Testing

We develop the customisation in a test environment, run thorough quality checks, and verify it works correctly with your live data.

04

Deployment & Training

We deploy to your live TallyPrime, train your team on how to use the new feature, and provide 30 days of post-deployment support.

Tell Us What You Need

Describe the report, template, or workflow you need — and we'll tell you how we can build it in TallyPrime. Most customisation requests get a quote within 24 hours.

Customisation FAQs

Will customisations break when TallyPrime updates?

TDL customisations are designed to be version-independent where possible. When TallyPrime releases a major update, we review and update your customisations as part of your AMC or at a fixed service fee.

Can you integrate TallyPrime with our website or other software?

Yes. We can build integrations between TallyPrime and external systems — including e-commerce platforms, CRM tools, and custom applications — using TallyPrime's ODBC and XML export capabilities.

How long does a customisation project take?

Simple template customisations take 1–3 days. Complex TDL development or integrations typically take 1–4 weeks depending on scope. We provide a timeline estimate before starting.

Do I need to be on a specific TallyPrime version?

We recommend keeping your TallyPrime on the latest version (covered by an active TSS). Customisations are built for the current version and tested before delivery.
